description: Fix three cross-layer follow-up inconsistencies: deliver follow-up terminal events to the web, unify the resolved-model event across OpenCode/Pi runtimes, and reconcile follow-up user-input activity state between web and server.

tasks.title: Web follow-up terminal event visibility
tasks.description: Add session.followup_completed and session.followup_failed to the web canonical transcript subscription set so the server delivery filter stops dropping them, and handle them as transcript terminals: close the in-flight follow-up round to the corresponding outcome and invalidate the agent-session/agent-activity queries so the session card/list refetches status. Reuse the existing session.closed handling pattern rather than adding a new dispatch domain.
acceptanceCriteria: The web canonical transcript event set (canonical-event-types.ts) includes session.followup_completed and session.followup_failed, with the subscription/routing compile-time guard still typechecking.
A follow-up completed/failed event is no longer dropped by the server per-connection delivery filter because the web now subscribes to both types.

On receiving session.followup_completed the in-flight follow-up round converges to completed; on session.followup_failed it converges to failed; in both cases the session's presented status is refreshed from the server and is NOT set to a global completed/failed terminal (web unit/DOM tests).
agent-session and agent-activity queries are invalidated on follow-up terminal receipt so the card/list converges (web test).
tasks.output: Web subscription + transcript terminal handling for follow-up completed/failed, with unit/DOM tests
tasks.notes: These are transcript events (handled before the reverse-DNS ROUTE table); do not add a ROUTE row. Mirror useSessionTranscript.ts session.closed handling and useWorkflowRunSessions.ts live-state update.

tasks.title: Unified resolved-model event across runtimes
tasks.description: Make the Pi projector emit a model.resolved event carrying resolvedModel (normalized to <provider>/<model> where parts are available, else the raw model string) instead of collapsing model changes into the dropped status event; keep the remaining status concerns (variant/stopReason) unchanged. On the server, standardize on resolvedModel in both the grain and TranscriptEventSummaryProjector by removing the divergent model fallback so live state and summary agree. Align the web model.resolved live-event contract (entities/agent/model/types.ts) to read resolvedModel instead of model. OpenCode runner path is unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: The Pi projector emits a model.resolved event with resolvedModel on a model change (runner projector unit test, no real network/process/wall-clock).
The remaining Pi status semantics (thinking level / stopReason / variant) are unchanged; model resolution is no longer carried only under status/model.
The server grain and TranscriptEventSummaryProjector both read resolvedModel and produce equal resolved-model values for the same event (server spec/unit tests).
The divergent model fallback is removed from the grain and no emitter relies on a model-only payload.
The web model.resolved live-event contract reads resolvedModel, not model (web type/test).
A session under either runtime surfaces its resolved model name via the transcript summary read model.
tasks.output: Pi model.resolved emission + server resolvedModel field standardization + web event-type alignment, with runner, server, and web tests
tasks.notes: The OpenCode runner already emits model.resolved/resolvedModel and needs no change; only the shared web model.resolved live-event type is aligned to resolvedModel. Confirm the Pi model_change event model field shape (string vs object) at implementation and normalize defensively.

tasks.title: Web follow-up activity-state reconciliation
tasks.description: On the web, stop driving the follow-up round's active/thinking/streaming indicators from the follow-up session.input event alone; gate them on runtime response events (message.delta, reasoning.delta, tool_call.*) which are the server's real activity signal, so the page never claims active while the server reports inactive. The follow-up prompt still renders as a round. Server activity semantics and the recovery invariant are left untouched.
acceptanceCriteria: A follow-up session.input no longer flips the active/thinking presentation on its own (web unit/DOM test).
While the session is reported inactive, the web does not present the follow-up input as a new active/thinking round; a runtime response event re-engages the active/thinking affordance.
Server ShouldRecordActivity, StatusName, and the Compact-after-rejected-followup recovery behavior are unchanged (existing AgentSessionRecoveryGrainSpecs test stays green).
After a rejected follow-up whose session.followup_failed is delivered (via T-001), the follow-up round renders as failed, consistent with the inactive status.
tasks.output: Web follow-up activity presentation gated on response events, with web tests
tasks.notes: Server-side LastDataAt refresh on the follow-up input is intentionally NOT taken: the input is uploaded before session.followup_failed even in the rejection path, so it would break the recovery invariant (AgentSessionRecoveryGrainSpecs.cs:322).
